prompt:
One continuous 15-second live-action film shot, portrait 9:16, with natural synchronized Mandarin production sound. The camera records a clean photographic scene without any graphic layer or writing. Picture 1 is the exact opening composition and architecture: son LEFT in the enclosed hallway, mother RIGHT in her home doorway, warm dry home interior beyond the door. Picture 2 fixes the young son and plain navy raincoat; Picture 3 fixes the mother, beige sweater and navy apron; Picture 4 fixes the single orange helmet; Picture 5 fixes the insulated soup bag; Picture 6 fixes the hallway, empty LEFT stool and RIGHT shelf with paper airplane. Preserve those identities, objects, sides and lighting.
0-2 seconds: Mother finishes easing the partly open door inward. Son waits with the bag in his RIGHT hand and his LEFT hand free. His orange helmet stays on his head.
2-6 seconds: Mother looks warmly at her son. In a natural, gentle older female Mandarin voice, she speaks exactly once: Wo dian de bu shi wai mai, shi ni. Speak these syllables as native Chinese speech, never as English words or visible text. Her own lips follow the speech. The son silently listens, face and lips visible in three-quarter side view.
6-8 seconds: The son looks back with restrained emotion. In a soft young male Mandarin voice, he answers once: Ma. His own lips visibly articulate that one word, while mother stays silent. Keep BOTH faces and mouths plainly visible throughout both spoken turns; no back-of-head view and no cutaway.
8-12 seconds: With his LEFT hand, the son lifts the one helmet off his head, lowers it onto the wooden stool to the LEFT of the door, and releases it. Show the whole path and the helmet resting on the stool. His RIGHT hand keeps holding the same bag.
12-15 seconds: Son, now bareheaded with short black hair, steps through the doorway into the warm home with his mother. The single helmet remains outside on the left stool; the bag stays in his right hand. Camera stays fixed in the hallway. Preserve a real interior behind the doorway, dry plaster walls and cupboard, never an outdoor alley. Door hinge, two brief spoken turns, coat rustle, helmet touching wood and faint distant rain make up the sound. No additional speech. Plain unbranded clothing and helmet, realistic hands, steady warm light, one uninterrupted camera recording.
